recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Stephen Whittle**, a 70-year-old man who advocates for gender recognition, was at the Chelsea flower show when the updated code of practice from the **Equality and Human Rights Commission** was published. Some welcomed it as a consolidation of last year's court victory, while others expressed concern about its practical implications for trans inclusivity.  Businesses and service providers are grappling with the changes, seeking clarity and time to adapt their policies.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mousa Taher**, a New Zealand activist, and other activists from the Global Sumud humanitarian aid flotilla, recounted harrowing experiences of abuse they endured while detained by **Israeli forces**. He also said that Israeli soldiers recognized him and addressed him by name because he had previously been detained. **Isselmou Ould Maloum**, a Mauritanian activist, echoed similar accounts of violence, stating that the Israeli military lacks a strategy other than using force against Palestinians.  **Gregory Terry**, an American activist, described the detention as "miserable" and said his fellow activists suffered broken bones and were repeatedly tased. **Juliet Lamont**, an Australian activist, recounted being subjected to sexual assault and physical violence during their time on board the flotilla. All of these activists expressed their determination to continue protesting for Palestinian freedom.

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma: Rival claims of murder and suicide set off media frenzy after Indian bride dies
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A dowry death case in India has sparked a media frenzy after the death of 33-year-old model and actor Twisha Sharma.  **Twisha's** parents allege she was tortured by her husband, **Samarth Singh**, and his mother, retired judge **Giribala Singh**, over dowry demands and that she was murdered. The police have lodged a case against the Singhs and are investigating whether her death was murder or suicide. **Giribala Singh** denies the allegations, claiming **Twisha** had mental health issues and committed suicide.  The case has drawn attention to the issue of dowry deaths in India, where thousands of women are murdered annually for bringing insufficient dowries.

recent_articles.title: UK pitched single market for goods with EU in pursuit of deeper trade ties | Brexit | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The UK government proposed a single market for goods with the EU as a means to reintegrate British trade. However, **EU officials** rejected this idea and suggested alternatives like a customs union or economic alignment through the European Economic Area.  Despite these setbacks, both sides are seeking agreements on food and agricultural products, emissions trading schemes, and youth mobility programs. The UK government is also pursuing closer defense cooperation with the EU. While negotiations remain stalled on defining a future agenda, both sides hope to announce deals before a summit tentatively scheduled for July 13th.
